title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE INSTITUTE FOR THE TRANSLATION OF KOREAN CLASSICS ACT

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE INSTITUTE FOR THE TRANSLATION OF KOREAN CLASSICS ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Composition of the Classical Translation Committee)
(1) The Classical Translation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") under Article 11 (1) of the Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall consist of no more than 15 members, including one chairperson.
(2) The members of the Committee shall be commissioned by the president of the Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") from among persons recommended or designated pursuant to Article 11 (2) of the Act.
(3) The term of office of a commissioned member shall be two years and may be renewed: Provided, That a member who is a public official shall serve for the duration of the official's tenure.

Article 3 (Operation of the Committee)
(1) The chairperson shall represent the Committee and exercise general supervision over its affairs.
(2) The chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the Committee.
(3) A meeting of the Committee shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of its incumbent members, and resolutions shall be adopted by the affirmative votes of a majority of the members present.
(4) Members attending meetings of the Committee may be paid allowances and travel expenses within budgetary limits: Provided, That this shall not apply where the meeting is directly related to the official duties of a member who is a public official.
(5) Matters necessary for the operation of the Committee, other than those prescribed in this Decree, shall be determined by the chairperson following a resolution of the Committee.

Article 4 (Executive Secretary and Clerk of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall have one executive secretary and one clerk to handle its administrative affairs.
(2) The executive secretary and the clerk shall be designated by the chairperson from among the employees of the Institute.

Article 5 (Request for Contributions in the Budget)
A request for budgetary contributions under Article 13 (2) of the Act shall be accompanied by the following documents:
1. A business plan for the following year;
2. Estimated statements of profit and loss and estimated balance sheets for the following year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the particulars of the requested budgetary contributions.

Article 6 (Gratuitous Lease, etc. of State Property)
The details, conditions, and period of transfer, gratuitous lease, or gratuitous use and enjoyment of State property under Article 14 of the Act shall be governed by a contract between the administrative agency responsible for the State property concerned and the Institute.

Article 7 (Disposition of Surplus)
If the Institute has a surplus as a result of the settlement of accounts for each business year, it shall use the surplus to offset accumulated losses carried forward and carry the remainder forward to the following year.

Article 8 (Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 25 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

ATTACHED TABLE
Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 8)
[Attached Table to the Enforcement Decree of the Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics Act, amended February 4, 2020]

1. General Standards
(a) The aggravated standards based on the number of violations shall apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding one year. The relevant period shall be calculated from the date on which the earlier administrative fine was imposed to the date on which the same violation was again committed and detected after that imposition.
(b) When imposing an aggravated fine under item (a), the applicable level shall be the next level after the level of the fine imposed immediately before the relevant violation. Where two or more fines were imposed during the period under item (a), the highest previous level shall be used.
(c) The imposing authority may reduce the amount specified in the individual standards in paragraph 2 by up to one half in any of the following circumstances: Provided, That no such reduction shall be granted to a violator who is in arrears on an administrative fine:
  (i) The violator falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 2-2 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Regulation of Violations of Public Order;
  (ii) The violation is recognized as resulting from minor negligence or error;
  (iii) The violator is recognized as having made efforts to rectify or eliminate the violation;
  (iv) A reduction is deemed necessary in view of the degree of the violation, its motive, its consequences, or other relevant circumstances.

2. Individual Standards

| Violation | Applicable Statutory Provision | First Violation | Second Violation | Third or Subsequent Violation |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Using the name "Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics" or a similar name in violation of Article 21 of the Act | Article 25 (1) of the Act | KRW 2,500,000 | KRW 3,500,000 | KRW 5,000,000 |
